Same field, same [0,1] range, different number where it applies. Scope stated precisely because an earlier draft of this entry overclaimed it: the correction fires only on POSITIVE lag-1 autocorrelation, so a mostly-flat strategy keeps the raw count and its verdict is bit-identical to 16; where it fires the shrink is sqrt((1-rho)/(1+rho)), and it can never RAISE a band.
